Hi Ilse. I can't set up this digest. I have no scheduling tool in this workspace, so nothing would run at 09:15 tomorrow, and I don't want to say it's set up when it isn't.

- **Who can see it:** You, Dana and Marcus are in both #north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1, so a digest of both channels in #north-team wouldn't show anyone anything they can't already see. Samir Patel is in the incident channel but not in #north-team.
- **Until a schedule exists:** If you ask me in the channel each morning, I'll post "North morning digest" with the previous day's activity from both channels.
- **To automate it:** Someone with admin access would need to add a recurring 09:15 job for me.
